purpose: Provide replay-ready illustrated beats for a procedural divine hearing inside an active furnace court, with stable routes, authority positions, witness objects, and branch-visible costs.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Segment routine, manifestation, hearing, opened route, and five aftermath states into distinct illustrated screens.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use a new visual scene for every change of focal area, horn state, visible divine response, authority geometry, or branch-persistent material consequence.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt restates the visible court geometry, lighting, people, objects, and staging in plain terms suitable for a general image model; modifiers describe only visible deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Painterly high-fantasy industrial illustration with precise stone-and-iron architecture, charcoal blacks, furnace amber, quench-water blue, restrained white divine glare, tactile soot and cloth, expressive work-worn faces, cinematic depth, and solemn wonder sharpened by dry human detail.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble the global style cue, then only the visual character refs for characters listed as visible in the selected scene, then the complete base image prompt, then every triggered state and branch modifier. Use the embedded Ash-Halo Court scene set as geometry authority for every camera slot.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one two-level court from wide, landing, trough, fitting-circle, and aftermath angles; branches alter drains, covers, racks, and character positions, so text-only memory is insufficient.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: If rendered, build a simple blockout from the embedded room model and camera slots before painterly generation; use camera-specific blockout frames as visual input.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the west upper landing into a rectangular black-stone furnace court twenty-four meters long and fourteen meters wide. A waist-high iron heat trunk crosses the floor toward a tall east gate arch. Four racks of overlapping iron scales and ceramic splints stand along the north wall beneath chain-hung counterweights. A long black iron quench trough and grated drain run along the south wall. Broad-shouldered forge workers in soot-dark sleeveless wool, leather aprons, cloth mouth wraps, and heavy gloves count rack marks under orange furnace light. Sedren, a stocky middle-aged custodian with brown skin, a shaved head, a square grey beard, a yellow chalk strap, and a long iron hook, marks one gear tooth. The central fitting circle is empty. Pale steam hangs low while cold blue light rises from the stair to the under-gallery.

scene_set.room_model: A rectangular upper furnace court twenty-four meters east-west by fourteen meters north-south. The west stair landing is 1.5 meters above the court floor and descends three steps near the southwest corner. A tall heat-gate arch opens at the east end. The fitting circle occupies the center. Four source racks and counterweight tracks line the north wall. A quench trough, grate, stop lever, and two drain branches line the south wall. The newer branch runs east down a shallow grade to an empty cooling bay; the old branch drops through a maintenance throat to an under-gallery and slag cistern below the south-central floor. The trough cover has one narrow west-edge inspection slit. Nema's registrar desk stands east of the fitting circle; Melka's witness table stands on the west landing.
